input: Research coliving spaces abroad for a workation

gold.taskTitle: Research coliving spaces abroad for a workation
gold.taskDescription: Research and identify suitable coliving spaces in a foreign location that support remote work during an extended working vacation.

questions.title: Which country or region are you targeting?
questions.description: Identify the geographic destination the user has in mind for the workation.

questions.title: How many weeks or months will you stay?
questions.description: Determine the intended duration of the workation to filter coliving spaces by minimum stay requirements.

questions.title: What is your total monthly budget for housing?
questions.description: Establish a clear budget ceiling so only financially viable coliving options are considered.

questions.title: What are your non-negotiable work setup requirements?
questions.description: Clarify must-have work infrastructure such as high-speed Wi-Fi, a dedicated desk, private room, or meeting rooms.

questions.title: Are you traveling solo or with someone else?
questions.description: Determine whether the search should cover solo accommodation or shared arrangements for a couple, friend group, or team.

questions.title: What type of community vibe are you looking for?
questions.description: Understand whether the user wants a social, event-heavy community or a quieter, focus-first environment.

questions.title: When are you planning to start this workation?
questions.description: Pin down the intended start date or window to check availability and account for booking lead times.
